description.zh: 需修改名称的云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance for which you want to update the name.

description.zh: 需更新的实例名称。取值无限制，建议长度不超过64个字符。
description.en: The new name of the instance. No limits are imposed on the value. We recommend that you set this parameter to a maximum of 64 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open update-instance-name --instance-id amqp-cn-zvp2ajsj0000 --instance-name amqp_test --region cn-hangzhou
